name: Vim pony
tips: `:wq` saves and quits in vim. Typed in the shell, bash doesn't know it: you were already out of vim!
Stuck in vim? Press Esc, then type `:q!` and Enter to leave without saving, or `:wq` to save and leave.
`vimtutor` is a 30-minute lesson that teaches vim inside vim. It is the best way to stop being afraid of it.
personal: I've been in vim since 1998. Don't ask how to leave.
Esc. Colon. W. Q. Every time.
